name: @ng-email/render
description: Render standalone Angular components to email-client-safe HTML and plain text on the server.

scripts.build: ng-packagr -p ng-package.json -c tsconfig.lib.json && cp ../../LICENSE README.md dist/
scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "console.error('Publish the built package instead: npm publish packages/render/dist'); process.exit(1)"
